disposition_reason: Original flame AAS measurements of lead and chromium in three red chili powder and three turmeric powder products from Lahore supermarkets.

study.design: Short communication; market sampling of spice powders
study.method: Flame AAS (Buck Scientific 210VGP) at 283.3 nm (Pb) and 357.9 nm (Cr); digestion details not described
study.qa: Calibration curves (R2 0.9968 Pb, 0.9988 Cr); no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Abstract and conclusion state Pb 0.0050-0.01 ppm and Cr 0.0430-0.1482 ppm, which do not match Table 2 (Pb 2-8 ppm; Cr 0.0104-0.1842 ppm).
Printed turmeric Pb mean (5.3) is not the mean of the printed sample values (6.0).
The paper says six brands; Table 2 shows three samples per spice (six samples total).
Basis, LOD and collection dates are not reported; integer lead values suggest low measurement resolution.
